newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on gains by financials.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on gains by financials.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended up on gains by financial shares amid buying by small investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 20.59 points to 978.07 on a turnover of 41 million taka.
Brokers said ICB mutual funds posted a solid gain followed by leasing and insurance stocks as investors found them attractive under the present circumtances.
Investors, however, were selective on food, engineering and other stocks.
ICB 8th Mutual Fund rose 14.48 taka to 254.48 and IDLC gained 17.08 to 1,790.
